steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Packaging nets are 2D templates that fold into 3D containers — understanding tabs, glue flaps and die-cuts is essential.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Sustainable packaging considers material choice, minimal waste, recyclability and environmental impact.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Print processes differ: offset litho for high-volume, digital for short runs and variable data, screen for speciality finishes.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Information graphics use visual design to communicate data clearly — charts, diagrams, maps and infographics.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Create a series of experimental studies exploring packaging and print design. Annotate your process. | Research an artist or designer who works with packaging and print design. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work. | Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with packaging and print design. Which approaches were most successful and why?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to packaging and print design, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outco | A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work. | A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Address ALL four Assessment Objectives — AO1 (develop), AO2 (refine), AO3 (record), AO4 (present) Show the FULL creative journey — from initial research to final outcome Annotate your work using specialist vocabulary (not just "I like it") Draw from primary sources wherever possible — real objects, not photos Experiment with a RANGE of media and techniques before selecting Make clear connections between artist research and your own developing work
